page-parsed.eventDescription: One successfully parsed source result page, $4 per 1,000 pages. Paid even when filters, exclusions or a recognized empty result leave zero rows. Source bootstrap/sort reads are included. Failed or blocked responses are not charged. No start fee; proxy and compute are included. See maxPagesPerSource; maxTotalChargeUsd is an Apify run option.

result.eventDescription: One delivered result with row keys title, url, domain, snippet, page, position. $1 per 1,000 rows, plus the separate parsed-page fee. Filtered, duplicate and excluded rows are not charged for the row event. No start fee; proxy and compute are included. Collection stops when the maxTotalChargeUsd run option cannot cover another page and row.
